They can offer guidance and suggestions for best practices should you have questions when building your forms and workflows, but our dedicated customer support team will not build forms for you.</p><p class="locale">The Jotform Enterprise Professional Services team can create your forms and workflows, and offer tailored and dedicated training for your unique use case.</p></div></div></div></li><li itemprop="mainEntity" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Question"><div class="qa-wrapper"><div class="question-wrapper"><div class="collapse" aria-label="Collapse the question" aria-hidden="true"></div><h3 class="qa-question locale" itemprop="name">What is the pricing structure for these services?</h3></div><div class="qa-answer" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Answer"><div itemprop="text"><p class="locale">Pricing for Jotform Enterprise Professional Services depends on the scope of your project and training needs. https://www.jotform.com/enterprise/profe.visible_text: Professional Services | Jotform Enterprise Enterprise Contact Sales Benefits Features ENTERPRISE FEATURES Teams Create shared online workspaces where your teams can collaborate. Multiple Users Collaborate seamlessly and securely with role-based access and centralized user management. Admin Console Manage your entire Enterprise environment from a single location. White Labeling Align branding across every asset, apply themes and logos, create custom domains, and more. Insights Track form submissions, workflows, app activity, document status, and AI agent conversations. Single Sign-On Enable single sign-on (SSO) to secure access and speed up the form-filling process. Local Data Residency Host your online forms and data in one of our 19 data centers (located in 15 different countries). Professional Services Expert-led form and workflow building services help optimize data collection and management. Onboarding Services Get a tour of the Jotform Enterprise platform and tailored training to meet your needs. See all features PRODUCTS Form Builder Create powerful forms with no-code conditional logic using a drag-and-drop builder. Workflows Automate business processes and reduce manual follow-ups with custom workflows. Jotform Sign Create and share documents to automate e-signature collection. Jotform AI Agents Use AI agents to enhance customer service 24-7, support staff, and more. Mobile App Collect data offline, collaborate with your team, and manage data from any device. Jotform Enterprise for Salesforce Create custom forms in minutes, prefill form data, and sync seamlessly. Solutions SOLUTIONS By Industries By Use Cases By Roles BY INDUSTRIES Government Drive digital transformation with secure online forms and service requests. Financial Services Manage client onboarding, loan applications, and compliance workflows. Education Manage student, faculty, and administrative processes with online forms and workflows. Business Services Digitize client intake, contracts, and approval processes to improve business operations. Healthcare Collect patient information and consent with HIPAA-enabled forms and e-sign documents. Nonprofits Collect volunteer applications, accept donations, manage donor records, and register attendees for events. Field Service Management Help field teams capture data, track work orders, and automate dispatching. Looking to partner with Jotform? Explore our partnership options Resources GET HELP FAQ Quickly find answers to all of your Jotform Enterprise questions. API Guide Go to the next level with automation and integrations using the Jotform API. Migration Guide Seamlessly move your data and digital assets to Enterprise without any downtime. LATEST CONTENT Webinar Jotform vs Jotform Enterprise: When it makes sense to upgrade Watch Now Webinar Rebuilding student registration at Chautauqua Elementary Watch Now Case Study Peggy Adams Animal Rescue League meets community needs with Jotform Enterprise Read Now LEARN Case Studies Newsletters Enterprise for Beginners Lunch and Learn Sessions Webinars Blogs White Papers See the differences between Standard and Enterprise Security Pricing Contact Sales Jotform Enterprise Professional Services Launch faster with professional services Fast-track onboarding, implementations, and more with a team committed to your success. Take advantage of expert-led builds and training to optimize forms and workflows and empower staff. Your projects are our priority. Contact Sales What you get with professional services 1 Consultation Tell us about your use cases and unique needs. Our experts will recommend a tailor-made solution to streamline and optimize your platform use. 2 Implementation Based on your unique specifications, we’ll build forms, documents, and workflows on your server for immediate use. We also offer bespoke training. 3 Proven Methods Drive success with expert advice shaped by real-world applications. Empower users with personalized training, no matter their experience level. Orientation and implementation services We work closely with your team to understand your requirements, goals, and nice-to-haves. Afterward, we’ll build custom forms, documents, and workflows tailored to your organization’s needs. Our orientation and implementation experts will help get your projects up and running with minimal downtime for your staff. Contact Sales Ongoing support for building forms and workflows Whether you’re a new user looking to extend your capabilities or a long-standing customer seeking further enhancements, our expert team is ready to assist you. Think of Jotform Enterprise Professional Services as a powerful tool you can leverage for custom forms, workflows, and more to help you continually adapt and evolve as your organization grows. Contact Sales Onboarding Get started quicker with Onboarding. Our customer success experts will provide a personalized experience that lays the foundation for long-term success and teaches your teams to harness the full power of the platform. Contact Sales Learn More Discover Jotform Enterprise premium benefits Local Data Residency Host your online forms and submission data in a local data center with Jotform Enterprise. Collect submission data from any device and store your data in any part of the world. Learn more Team Workspace Promote collaboration with shared workspaces for departments and cross-functional teams. Create and share forms, tables, reports, and apps to support team goals. Set role-based access for enhanced security and flexibility. Learn more User Management Effortlessly manage users, activity, mobile use, and more from the Admin Console dashboard: Grant organization- or team-level administrative access to adjust user permissions as needed. Learn more Custom Branding Customize the look and feel of your forms — including the URL — with Jotform Enterprise. Create consistent, on-brand experiences for your organization and your clients. Learn more Single Sign-On (SSO) Jotform Enterprise offers single sign-on (SSO) login options, streamlining and securing access to forms, submission data, and more. Use SSO prefill to speed up form-filling, increase conversions, and improve data accuracy. With Multi SSO, enable seamless login through multiple identity providers like Google and Microsoft, enhancing security, accessibility, and the user experience for dispersed teams. Learn more Advanced Security Protect your data with 256-bit SSL encryption and PCI-DSS Level I payment certification. Features to enable compliance with HIPAA, SOC 2, and other standards are also available. Learn more Connect with our experts Explore ways Jotform Enterprise Professional Services can support your goals and transform how you do business. Unlimited Forms & Use Unlimited Submissions Multiuser Platform Dedicated Support User Management Single Sign-On (SSO) Service Level Agreements (SLA) Data Residency Professional Services HIPAA-Enabled Features Available Custom Branding & Domain Testimonials There are tons of other products, but they don’t provide the same support as Jotform Enterprise. Ayyoub Ajmi Founder CiviLaw.tech Customer service is impressive and what separates Jotform Enterprise from the competition Jiku Park IT Manager County of Marin I’ve worked with several people from the Enterprise Customer Success team, and every one of them goes out of their way to make sure that what I build is working, and they do so with a smile on their face. I learn something new every time. Paul Cianci Director of Special Operations Freedom Boat Club FAQ What is Jotform Enterprise Professional Services? Jotform Enterprise Professional Services provides onboarding, implementation, and training support delivered by a team of dedicated experts who will provide tailored services to meet your specific needs. What does Jotform Enterprise Professional Services include? Three services are available: orientation and implementation, onboarding, training, and form and workflow building. Which Jotform plans can benefit from Professional Services? Professional Services are open to all Jotform Enterprise customers. Any organization that needs assistance with form and workflow building or custom training can benefit from our services. What types of support and training are available through Jotform Enterprise Professional Services? You can have forms and workflows built to streamline your onboarding process or to support new initiatives and enhancements to your existing Jotform Enterprise instance. Custom training is also available to accommodate users, admins, and all experience levels. How can these services help us tailor Jotform to our specific business needs? Get forms and workflows expertly designed specifically for your unique use case by our Jotform Enterprise Professional Services team. Whether you want to hit the ground running, revamp existing forms and workflows, or design a new process from the ground up, we can handle it. How do I request Jotform Enterprise Professional Services? Contact our Enterprise Sales team to discuss your unique needs and schedule a training or service. I am already an enterprise customer. How can I request professional services? Jotform Enterprise customers should contact their account manager to request professional services. You can also submit a request by contacting the customer success or support team. What is the typical duration for onboarding and implementation with these services? The length of orientation and implementation services will depend on your specific needs and use case. Do Jotform Enterprise Professional Services include hands-on assistance? Yes. Engage Jotform Enterprise Professional Services to build your forms and workflows for you. After identifying your unique needs, our team will work on customizing your specific Enterprise instance. You can also request training tailored for new or experienced users and admins. How do these professional services differ from standard Jotform Support? You can contact Jotform’s standard customer support 24-7 via our support page, but they do not offer custom-built forms and workflows. Additionally, you can get help to troubleshoot and answer your questions, but tailored, live training sessions aren’t provided through Jotform’s standard support team. How does Jotform Enterprise’s dedicated support differ from its Professional Services? The dedicated team of experienced support engineers who serve our Enterprise clients can answer questions submitted via our ticketing system and consult with you via scheduled Zoom calls. They can offer guidance and suggestions for best practices should you have questions when building your forms and workflows, but our dedicated customer support team will not build forms for you. The Jotform Enterprise Professional Services team can create your forms and workflows, and offer tailored and dedicated training for your unique use case. What is the pricing structure for these services? Pricing for Jotform Enterprise Professional Services depends on the scope of your project and training needs. To learn more or start a project, contact the Jotform Enterprise Sales team . Only the API call limit resets daily.</p><p class="locale"><strong>Submission limit:</strong> A form submission is the data collected when a user successfully completes a form. The submission limit refers to the total number of form responses from all forms that your account can support on a monthly basis.</p><p class="locale"><strong>Form view limit:</strong> The form view limit refers to the total number of times your forms can be viewed account-wide on a monthly basis. For more information, see <a href="https://www.jotform.com/help/355-form-view-limits-what-is-it-all-about/" target="_blank" class="link-blue" data-jfa="faq-12">Form View Limits</a>.</p><p class="locale"><strong>Form field limit:</strong> A form field is an element of a form, such as a text box, calculator, or signature field. The form field limit refers to the maximum number of elements and/or widgets allowed on a form.</p><p class="locale"><strong>Payment submission limit:</strong> A payment submission is a submission through a form that accepts payment via Jotform’s payment integrations. The payment submission limit is the total number of valid payments you collect with your forms on a monthly basis.</p><p class="locale"><strong>Signed document limit:</strong> The signed document limit refers to the total number of e-signature documents you receive on your account every month.</p><p class="locale"><strong>Total submission storage:</strong> Total submission storage refers to the maximum number of form submissions you can store in your account.</p><p class="locale"><strong>Upload space:</strong> Upload space is the available disk space you can use to store files uploaded to your forms. To free up upload space, you can delete and then purge any of your form entries that include file uploads.</p><p class="locale"><strong>HIPAA compliance features:</strong> HIPAA compliance features are optional features, such as encryption, auditing, and PHI segmentation, that you can use to help make sure your forms comply with HIPAA regulations. These features are available on <strong>Gold and Enterprise plans only.</strong></p><p class="locale"><strong>Jotform branding:</strong> Forms built by users on Jotform’s Starter plan include Jotform branding. Users on other Jotform plans can remove this branding and replace it with their own.</p></div></div></div></li><li itemprop="mainEntity" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Question"><div class="qa-wrapper "><div class="question-wrapper"><div class="collapse" aria-label="Collapse the question" aria-hidden="true"></div><h3 class="qa-question locale" itemprop="name">Which payment methods does Jotform accept for its plans?</h3></div><div class="qa-answer" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Answer" tabindex='-1' aria-hidden="false"><div itemprop="text"><p class="locale">Jotform accepts payments via credit/debit card or PayPal.</p></div></div></div></li><li itemprop="mainEntity" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Question"><div class="qa-wrapper "><div class="question-wrapper"><div class="collapse" aria-label="Collapse the question" aria-hidden="true"></div><h3 class="qa-question locale" itemprop="name">Which currencies does Jotform support?</h3></div><div class="qa-answer" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Answer" tabindex='-1' aria-hidden="false"><div itemprop="text"><p class="locale">Jotform charges its users in U.S. dollars or euros, depending on where you are located. Please note that you can see your converted local currency amount on your bank/credit card receipt.</p></div></div></div></li><li itemprop="mainEntity" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Question"><div class="qa-wrapper "><div class="question-wrapper"><div class="collapse" aria-label="Collapse the question" aria-hidden="true"></div><h3 class="qa-question locale" itemprop="name">Does the price include tax?</h3></div><div class="qa-answer" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Answer" tabindex='-1' aria-hidden="false"><div itemprop="text"><p class="locale">All payments made to Jotform will automatically include tax in the final price to comply with local regulations. Monthly Sessions cover chatbot views, page refreshes, and phone call starts, even if no active user interaction occurs. Monthly Voice Calls represent the total minutes AI Agents can use for phone or web call interactions each month. The Knowledge Base limit determines the total character count for knowledge resources across all AI Agents, including plain text, documents, Q&As, and URLs. Additionally, you can opt for a Dedicated Phone Number (Phone Number Add-On) for an extra fee to provide personalized services to your customers.</p></div></div></div></li><li itemprop="mainEntity" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Question"><div class="qa-wrapper "><div class="question-wrapper"><div class="collapse" aria-label="Collapse the question" aria-hidden="true"></div><h3 class="qa-question locale" itemprop="name">What is the difference between a Voice Call and a Phone Call?</h3></div><div class="qa-answer" itemprop="acceptedAnswer" itemscope itemtype="http://schema.org/Answer" tabindex='-1' aria-hidden="false"><div itemprop="text"><p class="locale">In terms of AI Agents, a phone call refers to calls made using a Dedicated Phone Number or a Regular Number with an extension number.             function checkBrowser() {
                var ua=navigator.userAgent,tem,M=ua.match(/(opera|chrome|safari|firefox|msie|trident(?=\/))\/?\s*(\d+)/i) || [];
                if(/trident/i.test(M[1])){
                        tem=/\brv[ :]+(\d+)/g.exec(ua) || [];
                        return {name:'IE',version:(tem[1]||'')};
                        }
                if(M[1]==='Chrome'){
                        tem=ua.match(/\bOPR|Edge\/(\d+)/)
                        if(tem!=null)   {return {name:'Opera', version:tem[1]};}
                        }
                M=M[2]? [M[1], M[2]]: [navigator.appName, navigator.appVersion, '-?'];
                if((tem=ua.match(/version\/(\d+)/i))!=null) {M.splice(1,1,tem[1]);}
                // return {
                // 	name: M[0],
                // 	version: M[1]
                // };

                document.querySelector("body").classList.add('browser-name-' + M[0].toLowerCase());
                document.querySelector("body").classList.add('browser-version-' + parseInt(M[1].toLowerCase()));
            }

            // Get IE or Edge browser version
            /**
             * detect IE
             * returns version of IE or false, if browser is not Internet Explorer
             */
            function detectIE() {
                var ua = window.navigator.userAgent;

                // Test values; Uncomment to check result …

                // IE 10
                // ua = 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; MSIE 10.0; Windows NT 6.2; Trident/6.0)';

                // IE 11
                // ua = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.3; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko';

                // Edge 12 (Spartan)
                // ua = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; WOW64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/39.0.2171.71 Safari/537.36 Edge/12.0';

                // Edge 13
                // ua = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/46.0.2486.0 Safari/537.36 Edge/13.10586';

                var msie = ua.indexOf('MSIE ');
                if (msie > 0) {
                    // IE 10 or older => return version number
                    return parseInt(ua.substring(msie + 5, ua.indexOf('.', msie)), 10);
                }

                var trident = ua.indexOf('Trident/');
                if (trident > 0) {
                    // IE 11 => return version number
                    var rv = ua.indexOf('rv:');
                    return parseInt(ua.substring(rv + 3, ua.indexOf('.', rv)), 10);
                }

                var edge = ua.indexOf('Edge/');
                if (edge > 0) {
                    // Edge (IE 12+) => return version number
                    return parseInt(ua.substring(edge + 5, ua.indexOf('.', edge)), 10);
                }

                // other browser
                return false;
            }

                if (!event || event.defaultPrevented) {

                if (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey || (typeof event.button === 'number' && event.button !== 0)) {
                    return;

                event.preventDefault();

                var href = event.currentTarget.getAttribute('href');
                if (href) {
                    history.pushState(null, '', href);
                }

                var target = document.getElementById('pricing-comparision-table');

                if (target && target.scrollIntoView) {
                    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                }
            }

                    document.querySelector("body").classList.add('browser-name-IE');
                    document.querySelector("body").classList.add('browser-version-' + IE);
                }
            });

Fortune 500 companies Jotform Pricing FAQ What plans and pricing tiers does Jotform offer? Jotform offers several plans, including Starter (free), Bronze, Silver, and Gold plans. Jotform also offers Enterprise plans with custom pricing for large organizations. Storage and submission limits increase with each level. Is there a free plan available for Jotform? Yes, the Starter plan is best for individuals or small teams just starting their data-collection journeys. The Starter plan includes all standard features , such as form templates , payment integrations , and widgets. You’ll need to switch to a paid plan to increase your limits. Keep in mind that your forms and signed documents will include Jotform branding, which can be removed once you have a paid subscription. Who is the Bronze plan suitable for? The Bronze plan is the lowest-priced paid plan. This plan is ideal for startups or freelancers who are hitting the ground running with data collection and need more than the basics. With its generous limits, the Bronze plan allows you to manage your business smoothly. Who is the Silver plan suitable for? The Silver plan provides the best value for small to mid-tier businesses. You can scale data management as your organization grows. Who is the Gold plan suitable for? The Gold plan offers the highest limits (outside of Enterprise plans) for your Jotform account and provides optional HIPAA compliance features. Alongside integrations, widgets, group approvals, etc., you can create HIPAA-enabled forms and collect medical information and electronic signatures from your patients. All data is encrypted so you won’t need to worry about keeping PHI submitted through your forms secure. Who is the Enterprise plan suitable for? The Jotform Enterprise plan is suitable for large organizations. It’s the only multiuser Jotform plan, and it provides additional functionality, including enhanced security, custom domains, Single Sign-On (SSO), HIPAA features, and more. For further information, please contact us . Is there a trial period for paid plans? While there is no trial period for Jotform plans, you can try all of Jotform’s standard features with the Starter (free) plan (this excludes HIPAA compliance features). Once you exceed the limits of the Starter plan, you can upgrade your account in a few easy steps. Jotform Subscription Periods You can select either a monthly or a yearly subscription. Your subscription will automatically be renewed each month for monthly plans and each year for yearly plans unless you cancel. Does Jotform offer discounts for educational institutions or nonprofits? Yes! Jotform offers exclusive 50% discounts on Bronze, Silver, and Gold plans — both monthly and yearly subscriptions — for educational institutions and nonprofits. To claim your discount, apply for the nonprofit discount , or the education discount . Once approved, you’ll be able to take advantage of the 50% discount. Are there any other discounts? Does Jotform have sales? Jotform offers several discounts at different times of the year. These discounts are available only when upgrading to a higher tier yearly plan. The discounts aren’t available for your current plan. Plans will auto-renew at the full price in the next payment period. What are the main benefits of upgrading to a paid plan? When you upgrade to a paid plan with Jotform, you’ll instantly get higher limits , allowing you to collect more data from the users driving your business. User data can ultimately lead to business insights that drive better decisions and save time, money, and resources. What happens to my data if I exceed my plan’s limits? When you reach a usage limit, the system will send you a notification email and warn you on your dashboard. You can upgrade your subscription to increase your limits or delete and purge your form submissions to free up space. Please note that if you exceed your total submission storage, the system will delete the oldest form response to make room for new submissions. To avoid losing data, you can download your old submissions and purge them. For detailed information, check out this help guide. What are the form usage metrics and limits that Jotform uses? Form limit: The form limit refers to the maximum number of forms that can be active on your plan. Usage limit: The usage limit is the maximum number of times you can use a feature. Only the API call limit resets daily. Submission limit: A form submission is the data collected when a user successfully completes a form. The submission limit refers to the total number of form responses from all forms that your account can support on a monthly basis. Form view limit: The form view limit refers to the total number of times your forms can be viewed account-wide on a monthly basis. For more information, see Form View Limits . Form field limit: A form field is an element of a form, such as a text box, calculator, or signature field. The form field limit refers to the maximum number of elements and/or widgets allowed on a form. Payment submission limit: A payment submission is a submission through a form that accepts payment via Jotform’s payment integrations. The payment submission limit is the total number of valid payments you collect with your forms on a monthly basis. Signed document limit: The signed document limit refers to the total number of e-signature documents you receive on your account every month. Total submission storage: Total submission storage refers to the maximum number of form submissions you can store in your account. Upload space: Upload space is the available disk space you can use to store files uploaded to your forms. To free up upload space, you can delete and then purge any of your form entries that include file uploads. HIPAA compliance features: HIPAA compliance features are optional features, such as encryption, auditing, and PHI segmentation, that you can use to help make sure your forms comply with HIPAA regulations. These features are available on Gold and Enterprise plans only. Jotform branding: Forms built by users on Jotform’s Starter plan include Jotform branding. Users on other Jotform plans can remove this branding and replace it with their own. Which payment methods does Jotform accept for its plans? Jotform accepts payments via credit/debit card or PayPal. Which currencies does Jotform support? Jotform charges its users in U.S. dollars or euros, depending on where you are located. If you’re located in Europe, you’re charged in euros. Those in the rest of the world are charged in U.S. dollars. Please note that you can see your converted local currency amount on your bank/credit card receipt. Does the price include tax? All payments made to Jotform will automatically include tax in the final price to comply with local regulations. If you have a valid Tax ID, tax will be removed from your transaction during the checkout process. If you have a Tax Exempt Certificate, please contact support to share your certificate, and we will handle it accordingly. Upgrades/downgrades/cancellations You can upgrade your plan at any time, and your limits will increase immediately. Any additional features included with your new plan will be available as soon as you upgrade. When upgrading your subscription, the unused time on your previous plan will be applied to your new plan, and you will pay a prorated subscription rate. When you downgrade to a plan with lower limits, these will be effective immediately. The unused time on your plan will be added to your account as a balance and will be used for your next invoice. If you would like to cancel your subscription and move to the Starter (free) plan, follow this guide . When you cancel a paid plan, you will still stay on your existing plan until the next billing date, and then you will be downgraded to the Starter plan. How is my data protected? Your data is safe with Jotform. Jotform uses Google Cloud and AWS for all our data center hosting needs and doesn’t maintain any in-house servers. Also, Jotform complies with the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Please visit the Jotform security page to learn more about it. What are the AI agents usage metrics and limits that Jotform has? Jotform’s AI Agent usage metrics and limits include several key parameters. The AI Agent limit defines the maximum number of active AI Agents in your account. Monthly Conversations refer to the total AI Agent conversations allowed per month, including both chat and phone interactions. Monthly Sessions cover chatbot views, page refreshes, and phone call starts, even if no active user interaction occurs. Monthly Voice Calls represent the total minutes AI Agents can use for phone or web call interactions each month. Monthly SMS specifies the maximum number of user SMS messages sent to all AI Agents in your account per month. The Knowledge Base limit determines the total character count for knowledge resources across all AI Agents, including plain text, documents, Q&As, and URLs. Additionally, you can opt for a Dedicated Phone Number (Phone Number Add-On) for an extra fee to provide personalized services to your customers. What is the difference between a Voice Call and a Phone Call? In terms of AI Agents, a phone call refers to calls made using a Dedicated Phone Number or a Regular Number with an extension number. These calls go through traditional telephony systems and require an actual phone number to connect. On the other hand, a voice call is a web-based call made through a platform without using a Dedicated Phone Number. It operates over the internet rather than through a traditional phone network. It’s important to note that the Monthly Voice Call Limit is shared between both Voice Calls and Phone Calls, meaning usage of either type will count towards the same limit. What is AI Agent’s Phone Number Add-on and what are its features? ​The Phone Number Add-on provides a dedicated phone number for your AI agent, enabling it to handle calls seamlessly. This feature ensures that your AI agent can interact with customers over voice, offering a more personalized experience. Calls made using this dedicated number count toward the shared Voice Call Limit. What are the period options for the Phone Number Add-on? The Phone Number Add-on is available with two subscription period options: Monthly and Yearly. You can choose the plan that best fits your needs. However, please note that you can save up to 20 percent off if you choose the yearly subscription model. Can I buy a Dedicated Phone Number Add-on on Jotform’s Starter plan? Yes, you can purchase the Dedicated Phone Number Add-on on our Starter plan. The add-on is available as an additional feature regardless of your subscription plan. How can I reactivate my previous Phone Number? Unfortunately, you can’t reactivate a previous phone number. Once a phone number is deactivated or the subscription is canceled, it cannot be reclaimed. You will need to purchase a new Dedicated Phone Number Add-on if you need a new number, but it won’t be the same as your previous one. Can I use my AI agent with an Extension Number? Yes, you can use your AI agent with an Extension Number found on the Publish tab of your Agent. However, please note that it may be challenging since callers will need to manually enter the extension to reach your agent. This process can be time-consuming and may affect the user experience. Which country phone number can I use with the Dedicated Phone Number? You can select a Dedicated Phone Number from the United States, United Kingdom, or Canada. These numbers can be purchased globally and are accessible to callers worldwide. Can I choose a specific area code for my AI Agent’s phone number? If you select the United States or Canada as the country when purchasing a dedicated phone number, you can also select an area code. Are the Dedicated Phone Number Add-ons one-time purchases? No, Dedicated Phone Number Add-ons are recurring subscriptions unless canceled. They will renew automatically based on the selected monthly or yearly billing cycle. How can I manage my phone number subscription? You can manage your phone number subscription by going to your Jotform account Settings and navigating to the Billing section. From there, you can update or cancel your subscription as needed. How do AI Agents improve data accuracy? AI Agents improve data accuracy by validating inputs in real-time and formatting user responses according to the required structure of a form. This reduces manual errors and enhances data consistency. How secure is the data handled by AI Agents? Jotform AI Agents adhere to industry-standard security protocols, ensuring that all data collected and processed is secure and encrypted. What AI service does AI Agents use? Jotform AI Agents use OpenAI’s GPT-4, hosted in a secure cloud environment, to provide responses. What are the security measures of the AI service? OpenAI’s GPT-4 is designed with enterprise-grade security, including encryption of data in transit and at rest and features supporting compliance with major regulations, like GDPR. Are AI Agents compliant with GDPR/CCPA? Jotform AI Agent features support compliance with global data protection regulations, ensuring transparency and control over personal data. Are AI Agents HIPAA-enabled? Yes, we utilize Google’s Gemini Models via Vertex AI for our HIPAA-compliant accounts, as it provides a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) to ensure compliance with HIPAA regulations. Learn more how Jotform enables HIPAA compliance. Does Jotform use the data collected through AI Agents to improve its services? Jotform doesn’t use the data collected through AI Agents to improve its services or for any other purposes, as stated in our Privacy Policy . Data collected from AI Agents is kept private, though we may share your data with AI providers such as OpenAI — but in any case it will be kept secure. Your form and form field content is used to train your personal AI Agents, but your name and other personal data won’t be used for such purposes. Learn more about Jotform AI Agents’s security features . What are the main benefits of AI Agents? AI Agents offer many benefits that enhance user experience and operational efficiency. They are friendly, communicating with users in a polite, empathetic, approachable, and supportive manner to foster trust and create a positive interaction experience. With real-time support, AI Agents provide instant answers and guidance, improving user satisfaction. Their scalability allows them to handle large volumes of interactions across multiple channels without compromising quality. Through personalization, AI Agents adapt to user behavior and preferences to deliver tailored experiences. They also enhance automation by streamlining workflows and handling repetitive tasks like approvals and data entry. Lastly, AI Agents improve efficiency by saving time and reducing costs through intelligent automation, replacing manual processes with smarter solutions. What are the main components of Jotform AI Agents? Jotform AI Agents consist of several complex and essential components that enhance their functionality. Functions define the core capabilities of AI Agents, enabling them to perform various tasks. Natural Language Processing (NLP) allows them to understand and respond to user queries effectively. The Knowledge Base stores important information that AI Agents use to provide accurate answers. A Decision-Making Engine helps process inputs and determine the best responses. Integrations enable seamless connections with other tools and platforms, while Customization Options allow users to tailor AI Agents to their specific needs. Avatars enhance user interaction by adding a visual identity. Multi-Channel Support ensures AI Agents can operate across different communication platforms. Here are some of the milestones that shaped how we help teams turn submissions into action.</p><div class="swiper-container swiper-journey-new mt-5 pb-48 relative"><div class="swiper-wrapper"><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2006</h3><p class="subtext locale">Aytekin Tank is sick and tired of having to code online forms and decides to create a faster, smarter alternative — Jotform, the first what-you-see-is-what-you-get (WYSIWYG) online form builder.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2013</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform reaches 1 million users.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2014</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform establishes its marketing team and opens its headquarters in San Francisco, one of the world’s largest tech hubs. New team members are hired to produce valuable content that Jotform users can benefit from.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2015</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform releases Encrypted Forms and Form Analytics, so users can add an additional layer of security to their forms and analyze their form data to reveal important insights. Jotform also celebrates 1 million widgets used.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2016</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform expands into 192 countries and reaches a new milestone of over 2 million forms created. More and more users get to power up their productivity with the easiest online form builder.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2017</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform launches <a href="/meet-jotform-4/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="Jotform-4.0-link">Jotform 4.0</a> — a revamped version of its original product. Improvements include an advanced form designer, powerful collaboration features, and the ability to build forms on a mobile device.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2018</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform launches <a href="/cards/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Cards-link">Jotform Cards</a>, an online form format that shows one question per screen, and <a href="/products/pdf-editor/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-PDF-Editor-link">Jotform PDF Editor</a>, a tool to turn form responses into elegant PDF documents. Jotform also introduces <a href="/hipaa/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Hipaa-Compliant-link">HIPAA form features</a> and <a href="/enterprise/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Enterprise-link">Jotform Enterprise</a> plans.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2019</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform holds its first Jotformers Week to celebrate the launch of <a href="/products/mobile-forms/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Mobile-Forms-link">Jotform Mobile Forms </a>— a free mobile app for iOS and Android that lets users collect and manage data anywhere. The app includes offline data collection and advanced form features like kiosk mode, which lets you collect multiple form responses on a single device — great for trade shows or conferences.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2020</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform launches <a href="/products/tables/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Tables-link">Jotform Tables</a>, an all-in-one workspace to collect, organize, and manage data, and <a href="/products/report-builder/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Report-Builder-link">Jotform Report Builder</a>, which turns your form responses into beautiful reports. Jotform also introduces <a href="/products/smart-pdf-forms/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Smart-PDF-Forms-link">Smart PDF Forms</a> a tool that makes it easy to fill out PDFs from any device.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2021</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform reaches <a href="/10million/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-10M-Users-link">10 million</a> users and undergoes a major rebranding. In addition to <a href="/prefill-forms/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Prefill-link">Jotform Prefill </a>, which speeds up the form-filling process, Jotform launches two new products: <a href="/products/approvals/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Approvals-link">Jotform Approvals</a>, which helps users automate their approval process, and <a href="/products/apps/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-Apps-link">Jotform Apps</a>, an easy-to-use no-code app builder.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2022</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform launches <a href="/enterprise/mobile-app/white-label/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-enterprise-mobile-link">Jotform White-Label app</a>, a powerful app for Enterprise users; <a href="/products/store-builder/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-store-builder-link">Jotform Store Builder</a>, a customizable online store to help users sell their products; <a href="/products/sign/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-sign-link">Jotform Sign</a>, an e-signature solution that lets anyone create, share, and e-sign documents in minutes; and <a href="/teams/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="JotForm-teams-link">Jotform Teams</a>, shared online workspaces that teams can use to collaborate within their organization.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2023</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform reaches 20 million users, launches a Jotform app for the <a href="https://appexchange.salesforce.com/appxListingDetail?listingId=a0N4V00000JTeWyUAL" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="Jotform-salesforce-appexchange-link">Salesforce AppExchange</a>, and releases the book series <a href="/jotform-for-beginners/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="Jotform-for-beginners-link">Jotform for Beginners, Vol. 1 & Vol. 2</a>.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2024</h3><p class="subtext locale">Jotform reached 25 million users, launched <a href="/products/workflows/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="Jotform-workflows-link">Jotform Workflows</a> to streamline complex processes, introduced <a href="/government/" class="subtext-link" role="link" target="_blank" data-jfa="Jotform-government-link">Jotform Government</a> for secure data management in public sectors, and celebrated the creation of over 50 million forms globally.</p></div><div class="swiper-slide"><h3 class="title">2025</h3><p class="subtext locale">In 2025, Jotform surpassed 35 million users. Contact Sales Explore Professional Services Enterprise Pricing Login Sign Up for Free About Jotform Jotform is an AI-powered online form builder and workflow automation platform. More than 40 million users worldwide rely on our products to create secure forms, collect important data, and turn submissions into action. Jotform serves teams across government , healthcare , education , nonprofits , SMBs , and enterprises . Our full suite of products includes Apps, AI Agents, and Workflows, as well as integrations with the tools you already use. Collect e-signatures, accept online payments, gather data on the go, and more. With powerful customization features, enterprise-grade security, and no-code functionality, Jotform makes capturing information and automating work at scale easy. See how customers use Jotform . Explore our 20th Anniversary story Trusted for 20 Years Jotform began with a simple question: How can we remove the friction of paperwork so people can focus on what matters? Twenty years later, that question still guides what we build. Today, millions of people rely on Jotform to collect data securely and turn submissions into workflows that drive real action. Explore our 20th Anniversary story Jotform’s Journey Two Decades of Redefining Productivity Since 2006, Jotform has grown from a form builder into a complete no-code platform for data collection and workflow automation. Here are some of the milestones that shaped how we help teams turn submissions into action. 2006 Aytekin Tank is sick and tired of having to code online forms and decides to create a faster, smarter alternative — Jotform, the first what-you-see-is-what-you-get (WYSIWYG) online form builder. 2013 Jotform reaches 1 million users. 2014 Jotform establishes its marketing team and opens its headquarters in San Francisco, one of the world’s largest tech hubs. New team members are hired to produce valuable content that Jotform users can benefit from. 2015 Jotform releases Encrypted Forms and Form Analytics, so users can add an additional layer of security to their forms and analyze their form data to reveal important insights. Jotform also celebrates 1 million widgets used. 2016 Jotform expands into 192 countries and reaches a new milestone of over 2 million forms created. More and more users get to power up their productivity with the easiest online form builder. 2017 Jotform launches Jotform 4.0 — a revamped version of its original product. Improvements include an advanced form designer, powerful collaboration features, and the ability to build forms on a mobile device. 2018 Jotform launches Jotform Cards , an online form format that shows one question per screen, and Jotform PDF Editor , a tool to turn form responses into elegant PDF documents. Jotform also introduces HIPAA form features and Jotform Enterprise plans. 2019 Jotform holds its first Jotformers Week to celebrate the launch of Jotform Mobile Forms — a free mobile app for iOS and Android that lets users collect and manage data anywhere. The app includes offline data collection and advanced form features like kiosk mode, which lets you collect multiple form responses on a single device — great for trade shows or conferences. 2020 Jotform launches Jotform Tables , an all-in-one workspace to collect, organize, and manage data, and Jotform Report Builder , which turns your form responses into beautiful reports. Jotform also introduces Smart PDF Forms a tool that makes it easy to fill out PDFs from any device. 2021 Jotform reaches 10 million users and undergoes a major rebranding. In addition to Jotform Prefill , which speeds up the form-filling process, Jotform launches two new products: Jotform Approvals , which helps users automate their approval process, and Jotform Apps , an easy-to-use no-code app builder. 2022 Jotform launches Jotform White-Label app , a powerful app for Enterprise users; Jotform Store Builder , a customizable online store to help users sell their products; Jotform Sign , an e-signature solution that lets anyone create, share, and e-sign documents in minutes; and Jotform Teams , shared online workspaces that teams can use to collaborate within their organization. 2023 Jotform reaches 20 million users, launches a Jotform app for the Salesforce AppExchange , and releases the book series Jotform for Beginners, Vol. 1 & Vol. 2 . 2024 Jotform reached 25 million users, launched Jotform Workflows to streamline complex processes, introduced Jotform Government for secure data management in public sectors, and celebrated the creation of over 50 million forms globally. 2025 In 2025, Jotform surpassed 35 million users. At the same time, we revolutionized the industry by launching Jotform AI Agents , which transform data collection into conversational experiences. Jotform’s extensive AI efforts enable organizations to automate tasks across 15 different channels, providing a more innovative and interactive way for users to engage with forms globally. Powering businesses one form at a time. At Jotform, we believe paperwork shouldn’t slow you down. We’re dedicated to making online data and payment collection as seamless as possible, so you can build a better workflow while building your business. Our Customers Jotform serves all kinds of industries and organizations across the world. With our easy-to-use Form Builder, limitless customization options, and a suite of integrations, Jotform offers top-tier flexibility and versatility to help teams of all shapes and sizes be more productive. Here are a few examples of organizations that use Jotform. Jotform by the Numbers Jotform Users 40M+ Form Submissions 2B+ Languages Available 16 Form Templates 20K+ Founder of Jotform Founder of Jotform Aytekin Tank is the founder and CEO of Jotform and author of Automate Your Busywork . He bootstrapped Jotform from the ground up and oversees its growth and development. In Aytekin’s free time, he loves writing and sharing business advice. You can find his articles on Forbes , Entrepreneur , Fast Company , the Jotform blog , and more. key_facts.description: Jotform is an AI-powered online form builder and workflow automation platform. More than 40 million users worldwide rely on our products to create secure forms, collect important data, and turn submissions into action. Jotform serves teams across government, healthcare, education, nonprofits, SMBs, and enterprises. Jotform's full suite of products includes Apps, AI Agents, and Workflows, as well as integrations with the tools you already use. Collect e-signatures, accept online payments, gather data on the go, and more.
